219:t_007:6.en:
$$シン$$
(A society that carried out the $$デスティニープラン$$... A thing like that is...)

219:t_007:7.en:
$$モニカ$$
「All units! I'm detecting a new force approaching this area!」

219:t_008:0.en:
$$レド$$
「We will annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. We can't let them live.」

219:t_008:2.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$ told me... The $$人類銀河同盟$$ that $$レド$$ belonged to existed for nothing but the fight against the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

219:t_008:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone born in the Alliance is raised as a soldier, and anyone who doesn't serve that purpose isn't allowed to live...」

219:t_008:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So for $$レド$$, fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is life itself...」

219:t_008:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's awful... Having your whole way of life decided by someone else...」

219:t_008:6.en:
$$シン$$
(A society that carried out the $$デスティニープラン$$... A thing like that is...)

219:t_008:7.en:
$$モニカ$$
「All units! I'm detecting a new force approaching this area!」

219:t_009:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「But that's a body color I've never seen!」

219:t_009:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「A new species...!? Or a mutant!」

219:t_010:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$バジュラ$$! They're heading straight for this ship!」

219:t_010:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Maybe they came to pick up $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$-chan, who are aboard this ship!」

219:t_011:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ are attacking this ship!」

219:t_011:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn! Are these guys the same as the other swarm that came to Earth!」

219:t_012:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「In the middle of the galaxy!?」

219:t_013:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「This is $$アンタレス$$ 1. From here on, I'll cover you.」

219:t_013:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$...! Is that really $$ブレラ・スターン$$!」

219:t_013:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「It's been a while, $$早乙女アルト$$. I never thought we'd meet again in a place like this.」

219:t_013:6.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「We're in the dead center of the galaxy...! That's way beyond coincidence!」

219:t_013:7.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Well, right now that's fine by me! Running into someone we know in a place we don't know is reassuring, isn't it!」

219:t_013:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I see. So $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ is here too...」

219:t_013:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Does that have something to do with you being here?」

219:t_013:10.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「We'll talk later. First, we get through this.」

219:t_013:12.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$ブレラ・スターン$$... A former $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ member, and $$ランカ$$'s brother as well.」

219:t_013:13.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ランカ$$ has another big brother besides Major $$オズマ$$...!?」

219:t_013:14.en:
$$カナリア$$
「It's a complicated story. Ask $$オズマ$$ about it yourself later.」

219:t_013:15.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! The $$バジュラ$$ and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ seem to recognize each other as enemies!」

219:t_013:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So it becomes a three-way fight.」

219:t_013:17.en:
$$レド$$
「If the monsters crush each other, all the better. We'll exploit that.」

219:t_013:18.en:
$$アルト$$
「Wait, $$レド$$! The $$バジュラ$$ are not monsters!」

219:t_013:19.en:
$$レド$$
「If they attack us, it makes no difference. In fact, the $$人類銀河同盟$$ is fighting them as well.」

219:t_013:21.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That is a fact」

219:t_013:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough, both of you. Do you want to die here?」

219:t_013:25.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Right now, focus only on getting through this! Don't think about anything else at all!」

219:t_013:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ブレラ$$! $$ランカ$$ is aboard the $$クォーター$$ too!」

219:t_013:27.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I see. Then all the more reason I can't die here.」

219:t_013:29.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'll open a breakthrough...! Let's go!」

219:t_014:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Just two days ago we were on Earth, and now we're in a three-way fight with monsters, with a planet whose name we don't even know in the corner of our eye...」

219:t_014:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「What's going to happen to us now...?」

219:t_014:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We'll think about that from here.」

219:t_014:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'm also concerned about the whereabouts of the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, which got separated from us, and the $$ミスリル$$ and $$プリベンター$$ members who we believe stayed on Earth.」

219:t_014:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I can't guarantee a return to Earth, but I can manage your safety for the time being.」

219:t_015:3.en:
$$マックス$$
「$$ミレーヌ$$! Is that really you, $$ミレーヌ$$!」

219:t_015:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Reporting in. Due to the large-scale $$時空震動|lc$$ after the $$再世戦争$$, I was transported to the center of the galaxy...」

219:t_015:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「and taken under the protection of the $$マクロス７船団$$.」

219:t_015:9.en:
$n
「The ultra-long-range emigrant fleet that $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ came from...」

219:t_016:2.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Don't tell me you're upset that the $$バジュラ$$ went home! Right now it's a matter of whether we survive or not...」
